root.label: Exceptions and stack unwinding
root.note: Throw creates an object, the search finds a handler, unwinding destroys locals on the way.

children.label: Exception object
children.note: Copy-initialized from the throw operand, with the operand's static type.

children.label: Static type
children.note: Throwing through a Base& throws a sliced Base; arrays decay, so throw "abc" throws const char*.

children.label: Unspecified storage
children.note: Allocated in an unspecified way, never by the global allocation functions.

children.label: Lifetime
children.note: Lives until the last handler exits without rethrowing and the last exception_ptr to it is gone.

children.label: Type requirements
children.note: Complete, not abstract, and copyable from a const lvalue since CWG 1863.

children.label: Handler matching
children.note: Handlers are tried in order of appearance; the first match wins.

children.label: Allowed matches
children.note: Same type, unambiguous public base, pointer or qualification conversion, nullptr_t to pointer.

children.label: No other conversions
children.note: No promotions, arithmetic or user-defined conversions: catch (long) misses an int.

children.label: catch (...) last
children.note: A catch-all that is not the last handler makes the program ill-formed.

children.label: Catch by reference
children.note: By value copies and slices; by reference sees the dynamic type and can modify the object.

children.label: Rethrowing
children.note: Two spellings with very different effects.

children.label: throw;
children.note: Rethrows the same exception object, keeping its dynamic type; terminates if none is active.

children.label: throw e;
children.note: Creates a new exception object of e's static type, slicing derived exceptions.

children.label: Stack unwinding
children.note: Automatic objects since the try block are destroyed in reverse order of construction.

children.label: Failing constructor
children.note: Built subobjects are destroyed; the object's own destructor never runs.

children.label: Function-try-block
children.note: Catches initializer exceptions; a constructor's handler always rethrows at its end.

children.label: uncaught_exceptions
children.note: Counts exceptions thrown but not yet caught; lets scope guards detect unwinding.

children.label: std::terminate
children.note: Called when exception handling itself cannot continue.

children.label: No handler
children.note: Whether the stack is unwound first is implementation-defined; GCC and Clang do not unwind.

children.label: noexcept violated
children.note: An exception leaving a non-throwing function, including a default destructor.

children.label: Throw during unwinding
children.note: A destructor run by unwinding that exits via an exception terminates the program.

children.label: Transporting exceptions
children.note: Library tools to store, move and chain exceptions.

children.label: exception_ptr
children.note: current_exception captures, rethrow_exception throws again, even on another thread.

children.label: nested_exception
children.note: throw_with_nested attaches the current exception; rethrow_if_nested recovers it.
